Riley, you can tell what makes a system an agent, and you chose the right fix for a stuck loop. **The main thing to work on is who runs the tools.** In q2 and q4, your answers had the model doing it. The model only writes a request. Your program runs the tool, then calls the model again with the result. This affects your budget, since one student question can take several model calls.

Also from q6: if the assistant needs to remember something between sessions, your program has to save it and give it back to the model.
